access.admin: Can access governance pages for moderation, users, OAuth, and bus. Active suspensions block admin mutations but not read-only admin pages/list endpoints.
access.agent: No admin tools are currently provided.

rules.divided-by-responsibility: The admin backend is divided by governance responsibility, not all actions on one page.
rules.moderation-centralized: Comment and description governance are currently centralized on the moderation page.
rules.high-risk-feedback: High-risk admin actions such as delete, suspend, and hide must have clear feedback.
rules.admin-self-protection: Admin user management must reject self-suspension, self-demotion, and removing the final remaining admin.
rules.admin-rest-session-only: Admin REST endpoints require the in-site Better Auth session cookie and do not accept OAuth bearer tokens.
rules.paginated-moderation-lists: Admin comments, descriptions, homeworks, and users use the shared { data, pagination } list envelope and accept page/pageSize with the deprecated limit alias.
rules.suspended-admin-write-gate: Admins with an active suspension may load read-only admin pages and list endpoints, but admin REST mutations and page actions are blocked with the standard suspended 403 response until the suspension is lifted.
rules.suspension-expiration-validation: Suspension expiration accepts omitted, null, or empty input as permanent and rejects invalid non-empty date strings.
rules.single-open-suspension: Each user can have at most one open suspension. Creating a new suspension closes any previous open suspension for that user while retaining history; lifting an open suspension clears the user's open suspension state.
rules.admin-mutation-not-found: PATCH /api/admin/comments/[id], POST /api/admin/suspensions, and PATCH /api/admin/users/[id] return 404 when the target record is not found.
rules.suspension-retention: Suspension history is retained when an admin account is deleted; creator and lifter actor references may be null after account deletion.
rules.primary-admin-navigation: The global shell exposes each admin tool (users, moderation, OAuth, and bus) under Admin tools. /admin redirects to /admin/users; resource URLs remain stable.
rules.feature-experience-telemetry: PostgreSQL stores unsampled feature observations for machine metrics. Collection records bounded feature, operation, protocol, surface, authentication, outcome, error class, identity, and wall-duration dimensions; Prometheus snapshots expose counters, duration histograms and activity gauges and deduplicate identified users independently per window. Anonymous visitors are not unique users.
rules.feature-experience-outcomes: Uninspected successful SvelteKit page data envelopes have unknown application outcomes and no identified error. They contribute to usage but not issue samples or warning logs.
rules.feature-experience-retention: Background writes retain at most 256 events per request and use independent PostgreSQL transactions. Overflow, process termination or database failure can lose records; missing history is not zero. Records are cleaned in bounded batches after 90 days, without historical backfill. No Analytics Engine API, token or binding is required.
rules.responsive-workspace: Admin management pages share a lightweight workspace order of page identity, optional feedback or filters, then records; desktop tables retain their density while existing compact record views remain the mobile presentation.
rules.platform-runtime-logs: Runtime issue rows contain safe event names, status and request IDs only. They omit arbitrary paths, messages, stacks, request bodies, search text, IP addresses and credentials. Telemetry writer failures cannot recursively generate telemetry writes.
rules.prometheus-export: GET /metrics accepts only the dedicated METRICS_SECRET as a Bearer credential. Missing configuration or invalid credentials return 401 without database reads. It exports durable event counters, cumulative duration histograms and current-state/activity gauges; no raw logs or user/request/client identifiers. This machine-only transport has no GraphQL or MCP equivalent.
rules.prometheus-collection: Counters begin at the recorded installation epoch, with no backfill, and update atomically with committed observations. Duplicate retained event IDs and rolled-back writes do not increment counters; retention and identity deletion never decrement them. Counters are fresh each scrape. Expensive gauges are cached 60 seconds (at most 120 during refresh contention); failures return 503.
rules.prometheus-windows: Only exact distinct-user/client gauges use rolling 24-hour, 7-day and 30-day windows. Feature activity is grouped by feature and protocol, excluding anonymous users. Event counters have no window label; duration histograms use feature, operation and protocol. Raw observation capture remains bounded and best effort.
